# Map Test dependencies

Luminati rendering modules come from [80e1aa6011159db7b88d52637d4b1112b1450ffa](https://gitlab.com/stubborn-hug/lumina/-/tree/80e1aa6011159db7b88d52637d4b1112b1450ffa). The original module paths and MIT license are preserved in `luminati/`.

The WebGL build and post-processing dependencies of [three.js 0.186.1](https://www.npmjs.com/package/three/v/0.186.1) come from the verified npm tarball. The import map uses the package's `three/addons/` alias for the copied examples modules. The MIT license is in `three/`.
